inputHashes: Each managed snapshot locks its manifest, metadataDocuments and rowFiles SHA-256 and size; inventories are retained in evidence storage.

outputs.index: Managed survey SQLite with SHA-256, buildKey and archived inputs in NativeGroup.survey
outputs.reverseLookup: Estimated spatial evidence with original footprint or native order-8 file range; file-range membership itself is exact
outputs.manifest: JSON/CSV metadata and source-supported URIs, with actual native order, source snapshot SHA and inventory limits

sources.title: Gaia DR3 main-source file partitions
sources.scope: Official Gaia DR3 gaia_source file roster; ICRS/NESTED order 8 inclusive ranges. Approximate source-ID position, not source occupancy or an image footprint. File bytes and upstream MD5 have not been independently verified.

sources.title: SDSS DR9 resolve fields
sources.scope: Official DR9 window_flist rerun 301 run/camcol/field membership and great-circle window bounds. Estimated ICRS geometry, not per-band image WCS or valid-pixel coverage; documented frame URIs are unverified.

sources.title: GALEX public image observation metadata
sources.scope: Locked public MAST image observations with original s_region and explicit GR6/GR7 source-URI evidence. Band/release/project selectors apply; bounded snapshots do not establish complete GALEX inventory.

sources.title: JWST early-release public NIRCam observations
sources.scope: Observed public calibrated MAST image metadata for the existing Carina and SMACS0723 NIRCam products. Explicit proposal and instrument selectors; planned or test records are excluded. Not an all-JWST inventory.

sources.title: VVV DR4 incremental Tile image metadata
sources.scope: ESO ObsCore rows restricted to the exact VVV DR4 release-description URL and image products. This captures the 11,452-row DR4 submission increment (including Ks metadata), not the cumulative DR4 inventory; only rows with H/J/Y/Z DataLink #this records receive direct file URIs. Footprints are transformed from ObsCore J2000 to ICRS and remain estimated; valid-pixel masks are not available.

sources.title: SkyMapper DR4 g/r/i CCD metadata (2014-03-15 to 18 increment)
sources.scope: The complete 2014-03-15 <= image_id < 2014-03-18 g/r/i CCD metadata increment (5,666 rows) from official dr4.ccds. This is not the full DR4 inventory. The source supplies CCD ICRS polygon estimates and original filenames; each access URI is a rule-derived 5-arcmin SIAP FITS cutout, not the complete CCD file. Cutout availability has not been checked per URI.
sources.query: SELECT image_id, ccd, filter, filename, coverage FROM dr4.ccds WHERE image_id >= 20140315000000 AND image_id < 20140318000000 AND filter IN ('g','r','i') ORDER BY image_id, ccd

sources.title: 2MASS 6X Atlas images (M31 one-degree increment)
sources.scope: One bounded 1.0-degree NASA/IPAC IRSA SIA query centered at ICRS 10.6847083, 41.26875 for dataset sx (6X Catalog), type A Atlas images. The 138 band-images cover 46 coadds in J/H/K and are not the full 6X inventory. Source FK5/J2000 SIN WCS frame edges are transformed to estimated ICRS polygons. Whole-image .fits.gz URIs follow the documented official IBE date/hemisphere/scan/name rule; individual files are unverified.

sources.title: 2MASS 6X Atlas images (LMC one-degree increment)
sources.scope: One bounded 1.0-degree NASA/IPAC IRSA SIA query centered at ICRS 80.894, -69.756 for dataset sx (6X Catalog), type A Atlas images. The 165 band-images cover 55 coadds in J/H/K and are not the full 6X inventory. Source FK5/J2000 SIN WCS frame edges are transformed to estimated ICRS polygons. Whole-image .fits.gz URIs follow the documented official IBE date/hemisphere/scan/name rule; individual files are unverified.

sources.title: DES DR2 normal five-band coadd Tile images
sources.scope: Official ivoa_des_dr2.siav1 inventory of all 10,169 DR2 normal g/r/i/z/Y coadd Tiles (one image per band, extension #1; _nobkg variants excluded). File-specific ICRS corners define estimated frame bounds. The source-listed Data Lab URL has no POS/SIZE cutout parameters; sampled response distinguishes the full 10,000x10,000 FITS image from smaller positional cutouts. Preserve literal '+' in positive-declination siaRef URLs: a sample HEAD returned 200 as listed and 500 when '+' was encoded as %2B. Individual file availability and valid-pixel masks are not verified.
sources.query: SELECT object, fileref, filter, obs_pub_did, access_url, ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ra3, dec3, ra4, dec4 FROM ivoa_des_dr2.siav1 WHERE obs_pub_did LIKE '%#1' AND filter IN ('g','r','i','z','Y') AND fileref NOT LIKE '%nobkg%' ORDER BY obs_pub_did

sources.title: ACT DR5 normal ACT-only whole-map FITS files
sources.scope: The six normal ACT-only ACT DR5 whole maps for 090/150/220 GHz with night/daynight selections. These are individual direct FITS files, not Tiles and not tar archives. FITS headers declare ICRS CAR maps with 43,200x10,320x3 axes; frame-edge geometry is an estimated RA/Dec envelope, not valid-pixel coverage. ACT+Planck, source-subtracted, variance and other roster products are excluded; full ACT DR5 product inventory is not claimed.
sources.query: Official ACT DR5 normal ACT-only whole-map selector: frequencies 090/150/220 GHz x night/daynight; lock the six matching FITS members from the official 42-file download script and capture only their FITS header blocks.

sources.title: SPHEREx QR2 v20 2025W17_4B observation 0001_1
sources.scope: One five-detector observation increment from the official QR2 level2 AWS mirror: 5 FITS images for observation 2025W17_4B_0001_1, processing path l2b-v20-2025-240, detector directories 2 through 6. ICRS TAN-SIP FITS image-frame edges are sampled from header-only range responses and remain estimated; valid-pixel masks and the rest of QR2 are not inventoried.

sources.title: DECaPS DR2 CCD image extensions
sources.scope: Complete 1,065,941-row DECaPS DR2 SIAv1 image-table inventory across g/i/r/Y/z, keyed by the source obs_pub_did including each FITS CCD extension. Source-listed Data Lab URLs identify the full CCD extension without POS/SIZE cutout parameters. Explicit SIAv1 ICRS corner coordinates use TPV image geometry and remain estimated frame bounds; valid-pixel masks and per-file availability are unverified.
sources.query: SELECT obs_collection, propid, obs_id, obs_pub_did, access_url, access_format, access_estsize, filter, im_naxis1, im_naxis2, wcsaxes1, wcsaxes2, date_obs, mjd_obs, expnum, exptime, fileref, proctype, prodtype, obstype, telescope, instrument_name, object, ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ra3, dec3, ra4, dec4 FROM ivoa_decaps_dr2.siav1 WHERE filter IN ('g','i','r','Y','z') ORDER BY obs_pub_did

sources.title: FDS DR1 science-image fields
sources.scope: The complete 97-row FDS DR1 science-image ObsCore roster (20 u, 26 g, 26 r, 25 i) from official ESO release 157; paired weight maps are ancillary evidence, not science image units. J2000 field polygons are transformed to estimated ICRS frame bounds. Individual file availability is not verified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 5000 dp_id, target_name, filter, obs_id, obs_creator_did, s_region, access_url, release_description FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection = 'FDS' AND release_description = 'https://www.eso.org/rm/api/v1/public/releaseDescriptions/157' AND dataproduct_type = 'image' ORDER BY dp_id

sources.title: VIKING DR1 J-band Tile images
sources.scope: Source-listed J-band VIKING DR1 Tile images from ESO release description 24. The locked selector returns 110 unique numeric Tile IDs while the release document declares 151 survey Tiles; this is a partial image roster, not complete VIKING J coverage. Original POLYGON J2000 image frames are transformed to estimated ICRS bounds; valid-pixel masks and per-file availability are unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 5000 dp_id, target_name, filter, obs_id, obs_creator_did, s_region, access_url, release_description, dataproduct_subtype FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection = 'VIKING' AND release_description = 'https://www.eso.org/rm/api/v1/public/releaseDescriptions/24' AND dataproduct_type = 'image' AND filter = 'J' AND (dataproduct_subtype IS NULL OR dataproduct_subtype = '') ORDER BY dp_id

sources.title: AllWISE W3/W4 Atlas Tile images
sources.scope: Complete 36,480-row W3/W4 intensity-image roster from the official AllWISE allwise_p3am_cdd TAP table: 18,240 coadd Tiles per band, with identical coadd ID sets. This is the declared Atlas source-table inventory; J2000 image-frame corners become estimated ICRS geometry, valid-pixel masks are unchecked, and individual file availability is unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 1000 coadd_id, band, ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ra3, dec3, ra4, dec4, crval1, crval2, crpix1, crpix2, naxis1, naxis2, ctype1, ctype2, cdelt1, cdelt2, crota2, equinox, cntr FROM allwise_p3am_cdd WHERE band IN (3,4) ORDER BY coadd_id, band

sources.title: CFHTLS Wide T0007 single-band median images
sources.scope: The complete 855-file CAOM selector for CFHTLS Wide T0007 single-band u/g/r/i/z median FITS images: 171 fields per band, with i split across 139 MP9701 and 32 MP9702 products. The separate 110 gri/gry/ryg RGB artifacts are excluded from this single-band source. CAOM ICRS frame polygons describe image frames, not valid-pixel masks; the listed CADC whole-file API route is derived from the source cadc: artifact URI and individually unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 1000 o.collection, o.observationID, o.obsID, p.productID, p.provenance_version, p.energy_bandpassName, p.position_bounds, p.position_dimension_naxis1, p.position_dimension_naxis2, a.artifactID, a.uri, a.productType, a.contentType, a.contentLength, a.contentChecksum, c.position_coordsys, c.position_equinox FROM caom2.Observation AS o JOIN caom2.Plane AS p ON o.obsID=p.obsID JOIN caom2.Artifact AS a ON a.planeID=p.planeID JOIN caom2.Part AS pt ON pt.artifactID=a.artifactID JOIN caom2.Chunk AS c ON c.partID=pt.partID WHERE o.collection='CFHTTERAPIX' AND o.observationID LIKE 'CFHTLS_W_%' AND p.provenance_version='T0007' AND a.productType='science' AND a.uri LIKE '%_T0007_MEDIAN.fits' AND p.energy_bandpassName IN ('g.MP9401','i.MP9701','i.MP9702','r.MP9601','u.MP9301','z.MP9801') ORDER BY o.observationID,p.productID,a.uri

sources.title: Pan-STARRS DR1 zone 23 stack skycells
sources.scope: All official zone 23 grid skycells (projection cells 1322-1411, 9,000 requested identities; approximately Dec 0-4 degrees across all RA). Only source-listed DR1 stack files with badflag=0 are indexed. The service responses and official grid table are locked as evidence. File URIs are direct STScI FITS links; individual availability and valid-pixel masks are unverified. This bounded zone is not the full Pan-STARRS DR1 inventory. Frame polygons follow the documented PS1 grid WCS rule, cross-checked against one metadata-only FITS header, and remain estimated.
